title: Payment Voucher
context: Finance › Payment Flow (Purchase Bill to Vendor Payment) › Payment Voucher

cards.title: Database schema architecture, journal tables, and models of fPaymentVoucher
cards.body:
fPaymentVoucher is a core cash and bank disbursement transaction interface in the FI module.
Header attributes map to Finance.FVoucherMain with primary key DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo.
Line items persist in Finance.FVoucherDetail capturing AccountId, DebitAmount, and CreditAmount.
Bank payment particulars write to Finance.FPaymentDetail storing ChequeNo, UTRNo, and BankName.
Tax deduction distributions persist in Finance.TDCTransactionDetail linked by VoucherDetailId.
Bill reference clearance links map to Finance.FBillReferenceDetail tracking parent bill IDs.
Entity state transitions are governed by DocumentStatus flags Initial, Release, and Authorized.
Optimistic concurrency relies on ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy columns verified on save execution.
Custom fields interface through masterdata.customfieldssave during transaction commit.
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity against ledger, bank, and currency master tables.
Audit trail triggers capture record modification history in Finance.FVoucherAuditDetail.
Transaction commits execute within serialized isolation levels to maintain accounting ledger integrity.
The schema enforces foreign key constraints across bank master and currency exchange tables.
Clustered indices on DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo optimize transaction search and ledger lookups.
Foreign key cascades verify referenced payment plans exist before voucher persistence commits.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.

cards.title: Validation logic, mathematical invariants, and error triggers in fPaymentVoucher
cards.body:
fPaymentVoucher evaluates strict accounting invariants prior to executing persistence routines in the database.
TotalDebitAmount != TotalCreditAmount raises an immediate validation error stopping execution on save.
DocumentDate < FinanceBookOpeningDate triggers date validation refusal.
FinanceBook closed flag in masterdata.mCalendarPeriod blocks transaction processing.
VoucherAmount > UserAuthorizationLimit aborts authorization with Limit exceeds exceptions.
Missing ChequeNo or UTRNo on bank payment modes fires mandatory payment detail errors.
ChequeDate < DocumentDate triggers date sequence validation refusal.
DocumentStatus == Authorized halts save attempts with Authorized entry can't be updated.
Duplicate cash or bank accounts selected in the grid fires duplicate account errors.
Validation checks execute sequentially within client pre-checks and server validation procedures.
Missing state details on accounts trigger geographic tax validation errors on save.
Structured exception codes returned by backend procedures are translated into user error messages.
Mathematical invariant checks evaluate total debits against total credits before invoking save routines.
Server procedures re-verify user authorization limits against masterdata tables to prevent privilege escalation.
Validation failures raise custom SQL error codes handled by the application exception layer.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.

cards.title: General Ledger mutations, bank reconciliation updates, and cascades
cards.body:
Document authorization executes General Ledger posting via Finance.FVoucherFinancePosting in the database.
Bank or cash ledger accounts are credited and vendor payable accounts are debited in FJournalDetail.
Entries write directly to Finance.FJournalMaster and Finance.FJournalDetail tables.
Bank reconciliation tables in Finance.FBankReconciliationDetail receive unpresented cheque lines.
Authorizing the voucher decrements DueAmount on linked Finance.FPurchaseBill rows.
Bills with zero remaining due balance transition DocumentStatus to Paid automatically.
If transaction failure occurs, all ledger postings and bill balance updates roll back completely.
Historical audit tables capture prior row states before detail line replacement executes.
Concurrency timestamps prevent detail replacement if another user modified the document.
Cascade handlers ensure accounts payable sub-ledgers reflect current net liabilities accurately.
Posted voucher numbers write back to parent payment advice records to establish audit lineage.
This posting interface maintains exact synchronization between treasury disbursements and the General Ledger.
Bank sub-ledgers update unpresented cheque queues to facilitate monthly statement reconciliation.
Reversal routines generate offsetting credit entries in FJournalDetail to maintain audit compliance.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.
